stablecoin_supply_hypothesis.hypothesis: Recent issuer snapshots may indicate lower circulating supply across USDC and RLUSD, but the dates, locale pages and source lineage differ. Cross-chain movements and differences in reporting cutoff can change network balances without changing global supply.
RLUSD or USDC can grow on XRPL while total issuer supply falls on other networks.
disconfirming_evidence_needed: Harmonized issuer snapshots show no decline after same-time rechecks.
Per-chain supply and bridge flows show redistribution rather than net redemption.
XRPL stablecoin activity and XRP bridge-path share do not move with global supply.
